title: What Iterated Self-Feeding Probes of Language Models Measure, and a test that separates the construction from the model
abstract: arXiv:2608.10986v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A growing class of methods probes a language model by feeding it its own output: self-consistency, iterated refinement, agentic loops. We ask what such a probe measures, in a construction chosen to make the question sharp: a ring of token cells resampled in place by the model's own windowed conditional p_r(x_i | x_{i+-r}). The substrate is Glauber dynamics on token sequences and is not new; what we change is the coupling. Advancing two rings that differ in one token under common random numbers makes undamaged copies diverge by exactly zero, so damage spreading becomes measurable where a maximal coupling gives mixing times instead. The answer is that it measures two different things at once, in readings that look alike. Some quantities are fixed by the construction: the damage light cone is kinematic, and the radius scaling of the token-space Lyapunov exponent lambda_ca(r) is model-invariant across 19 models and two scale ladders spanni

translated_title: 语言模型迭代自反馈探测的测量对象，以及一种将构造与模型分离的测试方法
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.10986v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：一类日益增长的方法通过让语言模型自身输出作为输入来探测模型：自一致性、迭代细化、代理循环。我们提出这样一个探测究竟测量什么的问题，在一个为使问题尖锐而设计的构造中：一个由标记单元组成的环，通过模型自身的窗口条件概率 p_r(x_i | x_{i±r}) 在原位重新采样。底层是标记序列上的格劳伯动力学，并非新事物；我们改变的是耦合方式。在公共随机数下推进两个仅一个标记不同的环，未损坏副本的差异精确为零，因此损伤传播变得可测量，而最大耦合给出的则是混合时间。答案是，它同时测量两种不同的事物，且读数看似相同。某些量由构造固定：损伤光锥是运动学的，标记空间李雅普诺夫指数 λ_ca(r) 的半径缩放跨19个模型和两个尺度阶梯具有模型不变性。
tldr: 本文通过一种精心设计的环状标记重采样构造，揭示了语言模型自反馈探测同时测量两种不同性质（动力学固定量与模型不变性），并提出一种将构造效应与模型自身特性分离的测试方法。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that iterated self-feeding probes of language models measure two distinct properties simultaneously via a carefully designed ring-resampling construction, and proposes a test separating construction effects from model-specific characteristics.
